A.title: The Flooded Stair
A.text: The steps are slick with brine and the fourth one is gone. Hold the left rail. A mason's chalk reads: low tide at the second bell.

Y.title: The Throne in the Water
Y.text: The ballroom is under three feet of seawater now. Chandeliers hang above it, dry and still lit. The throne on the dais has a high-water mark halfway up its back.

R.title: Half-Buried in Coral
R.text: Breathe as the tide does. In slow and out slow, and the water holds you up instead of pulling you under. A courtier cut the lesson into the stone before the flood took him.

G.title: A Courtier's Letter
G.text: Dearest Marin, the sea has come to the cellars. The Empress says it is a gift. I say she has not looked at the cellars. Bring your boots.

M.title: Reef Warning
M.text: The coral grows toward the living. It is faster than it looks. If a wall you passed is closer on the way back, do not go back that way.

O.title: The Short Way
O.text: Someone found a shortcut through the coral maze. Someone else found him in it. The coral turns with the current. Take the long way, and keep the water on your left.

U.title: A Pearl Diver's Count
U.text: Twenty breaths down, twenty up. The Court paid by the pearl, not by the day. Some of the divers are still counting.

X.title: The Empress's Altar
X.text: The Empress held court here under the water, among coral grown into altars. Her crown is not on the dais. A pearl diver's note says: look where the tide pools collect.
